exposure: Combined oxytocin (10 IU IM + 2.5 IU/hour IV for 4 hours) and misoprostol (600 mcg rectally)
Oxytocin alone (10 IU IM + 2.5 IU/hour IV for 4 hours)
outcome: Blood loss during and after caesarean delivery
cohort: The study involved 200 pregnant women undergoing elective caesarean section at a teaching hospital.
finding: Combined administration of misoprostol and oxytocin significantly reduced blood loss during and after caesarean delivery and resulted in a lower mean drop in postpartum haemoglobin compared to oxytocin alone.
